digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler mutate — DC convergence suites
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites that Cloud possesses for comment and description length, leaving oversized text handling unverified against two-pass truncation stability
DC comment sanitization binds to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT and the description fitter (fit_outbound), creating coupling risk even though both fit plain characters at 32767 for the default case
The correct ceiling (32767) is documented in Jira's jpm.xml as the default of jira.text.field.character.limit, which covers both Comments and Text custom fields by design, per JRASERVER-28519
Tests driven through config fallback resolve Cloud backend silently instead of DC, causing vacuous-green cells that pass while proving nothing about DC's actual truncation path

Convergence must be proven by two-pass assertion (second pass emits zero mutations), not by single-pass length or value checks, which can pass under either truncation function when both use identical limits and suffixes
